content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

I hope you’re well. Before I sign, I’d like to suggest a couple of small adjustments to the agreement:

- The relevant clause allows the client to terminate the agreement at any time without notice or further payment. This could leave me unpaid for work already completed. I propose that either party may terminate for convenience with 30 days written notice, and that the client pays for all services performed and expenses incurred up to the termination date.
- The relevant clause states that all intellectual property rights in each deliverable transfer to the client upon delivery. This would transfer ownership before I receive full payment. I propose that the rights transfer to the client upon full payment of the invoice for that deliverable.

Please let me know if these changes are acceptable. Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards
